scope: Buying and selling a pump.fun coin that is still on its bonding curve, at small size (0.04 SOL). Fees are percentages of the trade unless stated. Educational, not financial advice; fees change, so check each source before relying on them.

fields.venue_fee_pct: the app's or bot's own fee per buy and per sell, on top of the pump.fun curve fee; null = not a flat percentage
fields.round_trip_pct_at_0_04_sol: approximate total cost of one buy plus one sell of 0.04 SOL, including the 1.25% curve fee each way, the venue fee each way and network/priority fees and tips at the stated settings; desk estimate

base_fees.name: pump.fun bonding curve fee
base_fees.applies: every buy and every sell on the curve, whichever app or bot you use
base_fees.note: Split 0.30% creator / 0.95% protocol. On its own it costs about 2.5% per round trip, so every trade starts about 2.5% down.

base_fees.name: pump.fun site and app platform fee
base_fees.applies: trades placed on the pump.fun website or mobile app (not Terminal or third-party apps), since Oct 17, 2026

base_fees.name: Token account deposit (rent)
base_fees.applies: each new token you buy opens a token account holding about 0.002 SOL
base_fees.note: Not a fee: you get it back by closing the empty token account after selling. At 0.04 SOL it is about 5% of the trade if left behind.

venues.name: Jupiter (Manual mode)
venues.note: No Jupiter commission; you set slippage, priority fee and tip yourself.

venues.name: Backpack Wallet
venues.note: Zero fees on swaps and bridges in Backpack Wallet.

venues.name: Jupiter (Ultra mode)
venues.note: 0.5% on coins under 24 hours old (most pump.fun curve coins), 0.1% on most others; priority fee and tip are set automatically.

venues.name: Phantom
venues.note: Phantom fee on most swaps, plus network fees.

venues.name: Axiom
venues.note: Default priority fee 0.001 SOL plus a 0.001 SOL bribe (tip) per trade; volume cashback can lower the net fee.

venues.name: GMGN
venues.note: Priority fee and anti-MEV tips are set in its trade settings.

venues.name: BullX
venues.note: Suspended trading in its current app from June 1, 2026; wallet functions and withdrawals stayed open.

round_trips_at_0_04_sol.setup: GMGN at its minimum priority settings

lessons: At small size, fixed priority fees and tips dominate: 0.002 SOL each way is 10% of a 0.04 SOL round trip. Set them by hand.
Close token accounts after selling to reclaim the ~0.002 SOL deposit.
Every curve trade starts about 2.5% down because of pump.fun's 1.25% fee each way; no venue avoids it.
A 0% app fee is not a 0% trade: Jupiter Manual still costs about 3.0% round trip at 0.04 SOL.
